claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Progesterone at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since it is a physiological hormone whose antiproliferative effects in hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer occur at much lower concentrations and over longer exposures, and no non-specific cytotoxic mechanism (e.g., cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress) is expected at this concentration.
